prompt: Use case: illustration-story / identity-preserving animation key poses. All empty pixels alpha ZERO, no paper or grid. Reference is STYLE ONLY, not rabbit anatomy/colours. A friendly full-body blue/teal long-necked sauropod, pale belly, four solid legs and long tail. Only neck articulation changes; torso and leg lengths MUST remain identical. No new limbs, no tree.
